notes.title: Major Events in January 2025
notes.content:
Dear devil slayers, we believe that you are all very concerned about the final outcome of the Reincarnation Trial in the Pavilion of Spirits. Recently, our newspaper has obtained reliable information that a new crisis has arrived and a new journey is about to begin.

[h3]Here are the detailed contents of this issue:[/h3]

The source of the information for this news points to the sequel of our game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3312310/Devil_Slayer__Raksasi_2/]"Devil Slayer - Raksasi 2"[/url]. The store page of this new game has been officially launched. From the game introduction information, we can learn that major changes have taken place in the Pavilion of Spirits. The life and death of the members of the Samsara Society are unknown, and a reborn person has emerged. Who is she? What's her story? Can she help the devil slayer world get through the difficulties?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/7fbc0d896070b13e541a0191138a8a978d64b6b4.jpg[/img]
According to reliable sources, "Devil Slayer - Raksasi 2" is still under intense development and may conduct a closed beta test in the near future. It continues the characteristics of the previous game and also brings brand-new mechanisms, which will bring you a gaming experience that is both familiar and fresh. If you are interested in it, you are welcome to visit the store page of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3312310/Devil_Slayer__Raksasi_2/]"Devil Slayer - Raksasi 2"[/url] and add it to your wish list. Our newspaper will also continue to follow up and bring you the follow-up news.

Investigator of the Devil Slayer's Guild: Sundong Gong

notes.title: DLC "Incarnation of Darkness" is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/f52802565e0662da0708794c527d3a761119f7fe.png[/img]

The first lord of the Pavilion of Spirits passed away, and it fell under the control of the three of them. the Reincarnation Trials became radical and weird everywhere. Those scholars who were focused on research also began to feel uneasy, as if something uncontrollable was happening.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/3020bfa828f3af5807b8d6586e3a7cbac4f15372.jpg[/img]

A hidden plane exists at the Pavilion of Spirits, the secret base of three mysterious persons. Countless arcane implements brimming with energy riddle the area. This plane is called the [Pavilion of Darkness], the Reincarnation Trial's greatest secret.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/14bbf582d95ebf302d34421d96a53f52efdd5965.jpg[/img]

A mysterious person used an ancient technique to create eight beings from Soul Crystals. These beings became known as the Charim.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/d822bae3a36740161d4b5ba29a8ea79b8c644fd9.jpg[/img]

While possessing their original memories, the Soul Crystals have distorted the Charim into beings of pure hatred and violence. The trial they undergo within the dark dimension is known as the [Incarnation of Darkness]. Should a Charim grow powerful enough, they can break free and cross the boundaries between dimensions to exact the revenge they so vehemently seek.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1608191/Raksasi/

[h2]Incarnation of Darkness[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/c7eedc0ce387b5d78bace64b99bfe558b0d02ed0.jpg[/img]

The Incarnation of Darkness DLC comes with its own difficulty level. Anything can happen as the difficulty intensifies; the possibilities are endless.

[h2]8 Charim Characters[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/e05bdff22f827fb7a314474b88f0bd33ec915238.jpg[/img]

These brand-new characters come with unique weapons and talents. They are mighty indeed. But with great power comes great responsibility—the trials they face are even more terrifying.

[h2]16 New Relics[/h2]

As the Charim gains further strength, each will unlock 2 new relics for a total of 16.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/109a6be9bfcc4215a554745952498d7868c6b4fd.png[/img]

【Soul Set】
Doubles the souls gained from killing enemies. When you gain souls, gain an equal amount of magic power.
[list]
[*]Soul Jade
Taking a fatal blow while above 50 souls will remove 50 souls and revive you at full health. Can only be triggered once per room and has lower priority than Divine Soul Jade.
[i]"Dark Zone Research Notes": "A strange mutation from the old Divine Soul Jade. Unlike its predecessor, this one can be activated repeatedly at the cost of a huge amount of soul. Useful, but has its merits and its drawbacks."[/i]
[*]Demon Crystal
Casting a spell above 10 souls will remove 10 souls and cast Demon Crystal Tide.
[i]"Dark Zone Research Notes": "Demon Crystal is a relic made by mimicking Ajiela's power. When the owner casts a skill, they can expend souls to unleash a Demon Crystal Tide; very powerful indeed."[/i]
[*]Soul Hammer
Increases attack power by 30%; enemies struck by the owner of this effect staggers and take longer to recover from hits.
[i]"Dark Zone Research Notes": "I built this hammer based on forging techniques I learned from the hammer lady. It will allow its user to stagger their opponents for longer."[/i]
[*]Soul Blade
If your soul is above 0, gain 100% attack but lose 1 soul every 20 seconds.
[i]"Dark Zone Research Notes": "Soul Blade is an energy relic that can be applied to the user's weapon. Very powerful but drains a lot of souls."[/i]
[*]Soul Ward
Each successful Block restores 5 HP while a Perfect Block grants 5 seconds of invincibility.
[i]"Dark Zone Research Notes": "Soul Ward is the most successful soul relic yet! Any weapons or shields imbued with it will grant beneficial effects to its user when successfully parrying an attack!"[/i]
[*]Soul Pupil
The target takes 5 additional damage for each soul that they have.
[i]"Dark Zone Research Notes": "Soul Pupil is specially crafted for Soul Hunters. It turns anything with souls into juicy prey."[/i]
[*]Demonic Soul Converter
After using, convert 10 souls into 50 Magic Power.
[i]"Dark Zone Research Notes": "Turning souls into useful fuel is something I've wanted to do for a long time. This converter can convert souls into magic power, the results are somewhat unsatisfactory, however."[/i]
[*]Sanguine Soul Converter
After using, convert 10 HP into 1 soul.
[i]"Dark Zone Research Notes": "We usually obtain soul from living things. However, if only it was possible to extract souls from blood instead of killing the host... this converter is only a product of preliminary experiments."[/i]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/3a07a80cffcb2f450d61494a66af756ac6bb2081.png[/img]
【Rampage Set】
Gain the Heavenly Eye power. Randomly increase either HP, magic power, or attack power by 100. When the set is activated, reset the current chapter.
[list]
[*]Rampage Magnifier
The user becomes gigantic and doubles their Max HP, attack power is increased by 100%, movement is slowed, and can now damage enemies by sprinting into them.
[i]"Dark Zone Research Notes": "The Magnifier is a failed experiment that has yielded entertaining results. It does what its name suggests, albeit with very severe side effects."[/i]
[*]Unstable Collider
Attacking a target has a chance to either instantly kill the target, deal double damage, or deal no damage at all. This effect also affects you and bosses, except the instant death becomes taking triple damage.
[i]"Dark Zone Research Notes": "Collider is used to create tunnels in the fabric of space. Its effect is unstable, but who cares? We simply need to spend more resources and test it as much as we can. Or, might be more fun to use it for something entirely different."[/i]
[*]Unstable Converter
Every 30 seconds, your attributes will be changed to a random number. This includes HP, magic power, movement speed, attack power and different types of elemental damage.
[i]"Dark Zone Research Notes": "The converter was initially used to adjust certain data but was later found to be useful for other things. The only problem was that its parameters were sporadic and had to predict."[/i]
[*]Rampage Challenger
Can only be used once. Spawn a random enemy when used and grants a random reward upon defeating it.
[i]"Dark Zone Research Notes": "The challenger will create any living organism with sufficient ingredients and materials, it'll really create anything!"[/i]
[*]Mysterious Egg
Randomly hatch a Shade that follows you around.
[i]"Dark Zone Research Notes": "I love the mysterious egg! We have this game where we pick our egg and see which one of our hatchlings is the strongest."[/i]
[*]Rampage Morph Potion
Attacking a target has a chance to change the target into a random creature.
[i]"Dark Zone Research Notes": "No one wants to try the Morph Potion in the fear that they'll turn into something monstrous. So we applied this to weapons and start morphing our enemies, how fun!"[/i]
[*]Rampage Skill Enhancer
Using a skill gives a chance to create a Magic Power Orb, a Magic Potion, or lose some or even all magic power and create a large explosion.
[i]"Dark Zone Research Notes": "Skill enhancement has been a rather difficult procedure due to the unpredictable nature of the subject matter. Still, we managed to achieve the impossible, although the effect is still somewhat unsatisfactory."[/i]
[*]Rampage Summon Token
At any time or place, summon a random boss or challenger. Defeating them offers certain rewards.
[i]"Dark Zone Research Notes": "We originally wanted to create a bell that can summon friends. However, the result was something that could summon immensely powerful enemies. They said this is not bad either, how strange."[/i]
[/list]

The Reincarnation Trial to save the world is going in a strange direction, will it bring hope or destruction?

And don't forget to check the free-updated Boss Rush mode!

notes.title: Boss Rush! The Elysium of veterans!
notes.content:
[h1]New Challenge: Boss Rush[/h1]

Having gathered plenty of data, Yi Xue has now created a most interesting (hellish) challenge: [Boss Rush]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/3eaea07c02f84c3459f53acc33bb3599796b5afa.png[/img]

During this mode, you'll be faced with three groups, each comprising ten mighty foes. You will be forced to fight back-to-back until all ten foes have been bested.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/ffc691399bfae802d2a05b77d77858fa2ed52e0a.jpg[/img]

In return, Yi Xue has fashioned nine new relics based on the abilities of the various bosses. Ultimately, she has decided to name them [Boss Sets]. These unlock as you progress through the Boss Rush and best more foes.

[h1]New Relic: Boss Set[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/671ed3e0a13eb5cecd4e5d60abb15e2d9951c50a.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Ancient Fox Incense:
Usable once every chapter. Summon an Ancient Fox Incense to attack enemies.
[i]"Strange Tales from the Netherworld": "The Ancient Fox has a living incense burner with a mind of its own. It gives off a very pleasant smell that the Ancient Fox always uses it to light his smokes. Obviously, there are more things than meets eye about it."[/i]
[*]Singularity Boots:
Create a singularity when you dodge that drags enemies and deals a small amount of damage. Has a 10-second cooldown.
[i]"Samsara Society Record": "The Singularity Boot was our old CEO's most proud invention. The original pair, made personally by his hands, is being kept by the Witches of Kwenlun. We made replicas later on. However, their power is somewhat lacking compared to the original."[/i]
[*]Cranial Bugger:
Summon a Mini Oddity to fight for you. Has a 15-second cooldown and only one can be active at any given time.
[i]"The Record of Ancient Times": "There is a phenomenon within the Five Oddities called a Mini Oddity. It's a miniature, adolescent version of its bigger cousin that possesses some of their power but far less destructive."[/i]
[*]Abomination Sac:
Unleash malice in every direction when taking a hit or after a successful parry to slow and deal damage to enemies.
[i]"Yinyang Recipes": "The sac of the Gelatinous Abomination needs to be removed before being cooked. The removed sac has other special uses as a food charm."[/i]
[*]Evil Master's Charm:
When a Charged attack hits an enemy, summon a Divine Master's Charm at the target location and deal area damage.
[i]"Strange Tales from the Netherworld": "The Divine Master's Charm is derived from the virtuous study of Taoism. Its evil counterpart is not as righteous, but a lot more powerful."[/i]
[*]Thorn Seed:
Randomly summon up to 3 friendly Thorns in your vicinity. The attack power of the Thorns is dependent on the caster's own attributes.
[i]"Strange Tales from the Road": "The Thorn Devil is unintelligent and can be cultivated to serve humans if their seed could be acquired."[/i]
[*]Spike Vine:
Summon a lurking Spike Vine to attack enemies from time to time. The attack power of the Spike Vine is dependent on the caster's own attributes.
[i]"Strange Tales from the Road": "Spike Vine is a symbiotic devil that grows on powerful hosts and serves their host's purpose. There are rumors that someone grew these on themselves and managed to bend the vines to their will."[/i]
[*]Stink Pill:
Dodging, taking hits, or successfully parrying will unleash a stinky gas cloud that damages any enemies that enter it. The power is dependent on the caster's own attributes.
[i]"The Record of Ancient Times": "It's said the Weasel Devils has a special pill that makes whoever takes it fart uncontrollably. This gas, while humorous, has the ability to damage enemies."[/i]
[*]Thunder Eye:
Cast Sky Thunder against your target when successfully parrying an attack; if you take a hit, cast Rampant Thunder instead. The power is dependent on the caster's own attributes.
[i]"Artifacts Explained": "It's said that the ancient gods possessed an actual Acalanatha that derives its power from an energy crystal called the Thunder Eye."[/i]
[/list]
Set Effect: Attacks that land on a boss will create projectiles with the total power equaling your attack power. While in a boss fight, you gain an additional 30% damage reduction.

notes.title: Advance Notice: Netherworld
notes.content:
[h1]Netherworld[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/ca9870e20a76ed6567987ad9f21add5f278692f4.png[/img]
The Netherworld, or rather the Realm of the Dead, is in reality a space interconnected with our world. It coexists with the world, or perhaps the realm crashed into ours at some point, no one knows. The Netherworld overlap with our world at several locations, the most well-known being the Netherworld Way. By traversing this intersection one can pass between the two realms. Some say that the souls of the dead are drawn toward the Netherworld, but the reality is not as cut and dry. First, few actually know the location of the Netherworld Way; second, those with strength enough to pass are few and far between.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/dc784972fbb9a39ace168c3f8526fe738bff93a6.png[/img]
In the Netherworld there are evil spirits on the prowl, some of their number are enormous. Evil spirits are surprisingly weak, yet it's dangerous if too many set their sites on you. Their incorporeal bodies allow them to pass right through your weapons and attack you. There are two explanations for where this type of ghost comes from. One has it that they are a race created in the Netherworld. The other has it that they are the spirits of those departed from our world. There is yet another explanation though, and that is that the Netherworld are a world that lives off of our own like a parasite.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/a12822e4fb802e6e84864b06322ff7adcb1720b2.png[/img]
There are two Mandarin officials of extraordinary ability that stand guard over the Netherworld Way, one white and one black. They are charged with preventing humans and ghosts from travelling back and forth between the two worlds. Thanks to them, the influence of the two worlds on one another has certainly decreased. The white-clad Mandarin wields a mourning stick, which can shatter any spirit armor and absorb magic power. Legend has it that the White Ghost Mandarin will knock out any person crossing the Netherworld Way and throw them into the Santu River, the River of Three Crossings. The black-clad Mandarin wields a Soulbinder Cord that it can use to shatter any spirit armor. If it is used to ensnare a target, it will rob them of their magic power. Legend has it that the Black Ghost Mandarin will seize upon any ghosts that attempt to cross the Netherworld Way and drag them back to the Netherworld.

[h1]The New Boss[/h1]

[h2]Meng Po[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/0fc6ee1e317a8bdf789838b446af07c0630266ff.png[/img]
"Strange Tales from the Netherworld"
In life, Meng Po was a Yinyang thaumaturgist who once conducted research into and explored the Netherworld. A portion of this book comes from her own handwritten manuscripts. Meng Po lost a battle of love against her rival in her later years, and so died after taking a homemade poison. What's curious is that after she passed, her spirit proceeded to the Netherworld via the Netherworld Way. It was later found that she was residing in the Netherworld Way. All who journey to the Netherworld and all ghosts that come back to this mortal coil, all must eat her soup. By her influence, the influence of the two worlds upon each other seems to have lessened.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/9d339321cb2f294d69422d90b143aafd4e421e5c.png[/img]
[h3]Meng Po Soup[/h3]
Consumable item. A random Relic is lost upon consumption, but three random ones are granted.
"Strange Tales from the Netherworld"
Meng Po of the Netherworld Way has a bottomless pot of soup that possesses a strange effect wherein it is able to rewrite the memories of whomever consumes it. While legend has it the soup is meant to relieve one of worries leftover from their past life, the truth is not so simple.

[h2]Nether Queen[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/b5f872a88903ea4e15db373994a0b663091880f8.png[/img]
"Strange Tales from the Netherworld"
Numbering amongst the few Ghost Empresses of the Netherworld is the breathtaking Nether Queen. She is notoriously fickle, liable to disappear at the drop of a hat, perhaps off to roam the mortal coil, perhaps not. Her temperament is likewise notoriously mercurial, becoming enraged for seemingly no reason. She's just as liable to launch an attack as she is to stand by on the sidelines in utter silence observing the drama unfold before her. All that have seen her have had themselves robbed of the blood flowing through their veins in short order by her lustrous, silken hair. It has never ended well for either party when she has set her sights upon a Devil Slayer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/8af266b6618ce4f4094e21d412e905a393d7f455.png[/img]
[h3]A Strand of Sable Hair[/h3]
Shoots out threads that strike at enemies through the ground, dealing damage and inflicts bleed.
"Strange Tales from the Netherworld"
Many a ghost story consists of hair that is able to grow on its own and steal lives. As far as we know Nether Queen's hair does possess this ability. Her silken hair still possesses vitality even if separated from her body.

[h2]Rising Moon[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/76e70b1826e861138ef4c50b11fcff749ce857c2.png[/img]
"Strange Tales from the Netherworld"
We've been quite curious about the Netherworld, for a millennium in fact. Our research into this world has never stopped. The most effective way is to send the souls of the recently departed, though this has not been without incident. Ten years ago, the tragedy of Hongde Xu created conflict, and we ended up using soul transmission to extend his life in the Netherworld. We lost contact with his spirit after that though. We did bump into his wandering spirit in the Netherworld later on, though he had forgotten everything, and even attacked us. We suspect that it could well be that our actions were discovered and a formidable inhabitant of the Netherworld decided to intervene, hence Hongde Xu attacking us. Rising Moon has become a terrifying force, nay a specter that haunts our efforts in the Netherworld.

[h3]Frostrend[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/fefea62c10891e8453308590024d724c3b2dd6b8.png[/img]
A longsword born of the Netherworld. Cold enough to freeze the very ground itself, making slows against enemies twice as potent.
X-X-X: Slash-Slash-Chop (Guard Break, Smash, Freeze)
X Charge up: Double Slash (Guard Break, Freeze)
Y: Chop (Guard Break, Smash)
Y Hold: Riposte (Guard Break, Smash, Freeze)
B: Dodge (40 stamina)
"Strange Tales from the Netherworld"
Having been transformed into Rising Moon within the Netherworld, Hongde Xu received a new artifact—Frostrend. This weapon is born of the Netherworld and emits howling winds capable of freezing the very ground itself. Should it appear in the mortal realm it will definitely make it into the Compendium of Arms.

[h2]Miss Mu[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/90a1fd0e3c9e1512286fd98a823ff77a3649423e.png[/img]
"Strange Tales from the Netherworld"
I was during my youth fortunate enough to encounter the primal fox, Miss Mu, and from her I learned the exploding palm, a technique I've used throughout my life. I love smoking, perhaps a habit I picked up from her. She is indifferent to the world at large but loves exploring new and strange places. However, she entered the Netherworld Way some decades ago, disappearing without a trace.

[h3]Hongde's Letter[/h3]
Hongde Xu's corporeal form. Once hit points drop to 0 you will return to your original form. Usable one time per chapter.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/3eacf3f8e1fc483076a63cf4dcec1f41080e9fc4.png[/img]
X-X-X: Dash Slash - Dash Slash - Pierce (defense break, knockdown)
X Hold: Riposte (defense break)
Y: Tornado Gale (defense break, knockback, knockdown)
Y Charge up: Heavenly Punishment (defense break)
B: Dodge (30 stamina)

[h1]Muramasa[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/e35ed5b796a4498406ef948240b9db9425ccc9b2.png[/img]
Soul Prison: Steal a target's soul upon killing them. Soulrend: Release souls to attack enemies.
X-X: Double Iaijutsu
X Hold: Riposte (Guard Break)
Y: Iaijutsu
Y Charge up: Soulrend (Guard Break, 80 stamina, Release Souls)
B: Dodge (40 stamina)
"Compendium of Arms: The Lost"
Muramasa is a longsword of unknown origin engraved with the name Muramasa. Enemies slain by this blade have their souls imprisoned, something which has given it the name Muramasa, the Demon Blade. There is little known about this weapon and the little that is known is currently not included in the list.

[h1]# New Player Character[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/73c9fcf9649b7a26f84b962f86176aab98ca4155.jpg[/img]


[h1]# New Soul Charms[/h1]

- [b]Create (Wooden)[/b]: Harziel's Star Shuriken no longer bounces. Instead, additional shuriken are launched based on bounces.

[h1]# New Soul Spell[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/0ab178472523de4e324045cb09c6eeb9a00b9c2f.jpg[/img]


[h1]# New Relics[/h1]

- [b]Chi Dragon[/b]: A little dragon that can breathe three types of flame. It will typically rest on your arm and will breathe fire ever so often when you attack.
- [b]Star Core[/b]: Revolves around the owner, dealing damage to enemies and protecting the owner from attacks. It disappears when the owner dies and will not be revived along with the owner.
- [b]Tangtang[/b]: Tangtang will use high-level combat skills to aid you in battle. Familiars cannot die, but require time to recover when defeated.

notes.title: 预告！天麓山与蓝霞！
notes.content:
各位斩妖人，久等了，

《斩妖Raksasi》新版本“天麓山与蓝霞”，已经准备了一段时间，马上要与大家见面。在迎接新挑战之前，请允许我来介绍一下天麓山与蓝霞的一些背景故事。


[h1]天麓山[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/529b11a2c233302db23d93c8e8eed8cef6fbeacd.jpg[/img]
如果你有足够实力，在激活5个以上木牒的情况下通过六章试炼，则在终之屋会见到石老，他可以把你传送至神秘的天麓山。这个隐藏的试炼章节，可以放心挑战，即使失败也能获取原有的奖励。

[h2]神族遗址[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/e4386071a28ebee11d8f772b17fec3638d58e2e4.jpg[/img]
天麓山位于南部武陵山区，地势险要。无数石英砂岩构成的柱状山，形成大遍峰林。很多柱状山，山峰顶部平整，山峰间有古老的索道相连，在云雾中构成一个天空之城。这是现存唯一一个完整的神族遗址，有珈蓝天众守护，外人难以进入。

[h2]珈蓝实验与珈蓝天众[/h2]
上古时期，天麓山属于神族领地，在这里进行了著名的珈蓝传承。这个实验以神族传承为目的，但最终失败，创造了一个半神种族——珈蓝天众。珈蓝天众拥有类似神族的永恒寿命，但灵智极低，只能执行预设指令，比如守护天麓山。天麓山远离上古战场，没被大战涉及，最终保留至今。数千年来，珈蓝天众一直守护着这失去主人的实验基地。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/452af55c5c99783792dd5baf09ab45edc640e14b.jpg[/img]
珈蓝天众的守卫队伍被称之为“旗”，旗官居中指挥，矛卫与锤卫负责战斗。旗官红蓝两色旗可以切换队伍的攻防状态，红旗主攻，速度与攻击提升但身体脆弱；蓝旗防守，速度下降但身躯坚硬。珈蓝天众这一战斗队伍，均拥有飞行能力，在天麓山中拥有战斗优势。

[h2]天麓山的生灵[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/2b2702b297bf10586e14e3444654ec12cb91dd4a.jpg[/img]
[h3]哮天犬[/h3]
犬形态的珈蓝天众，无法飞行，但擅长追捕，会配合“旗”进行战斗，捕猎逃跑的敌人。前往天麓山的冒险者，很难全身而退，主要是无法摆脱哮天犬的纠缠。
[h3]雷震子[/h3]
《上古记》：演义里描述的雷震子，创作原形是上古神族阵营中一种飞行生灵，他拥有人的形态，有双翼能飞行，操控雷电。从神族留下的文献猜测，这种雷震子，可能是珈蓝天众的一种。这几千年来，民间一直有雷震子出现的记载，神族研究学者猜测，只要有雷电存在，雷震子就可以一直生存和繁衍。
[h3]怒之傩[/h3]
《上古记》：上古大战中，神族使用了很多机关兽，其中怒之傩最为知名，甚至在我族文献中也都有多处记载。据记录，怒之傩飞行于空中，如一巨大鬼脸，有双手，能吐雷与火，在大战中给对手带来巨大破坏。后来民间参照怒之傩的描述，演化出傩舞，以祭神跳鬼，驱瘟避疫。

[h2]法珠与法阵[/h2]
天麓山遍布神族遗留的法珠神器，当有敌人靠近，法珠将激活各种奇特阵法，让入侵者陷入被动。只有击破法珠，才可解除阵法效果。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/72104a53e6a3f6b2708e0daff5c81073d16d049b.jpg[/img]
- 杀戮法珠：产生类似杀戮诅咒的效果，无法免疫，并能与杀戮诅咒叠加。
- 重力法珠：所有人移动速度下降。
- 轻盈法珠：所有人移动速度提升。
- 霸体法珠：所有人拥有霸体效果。
- 盲目法珠：所有人盲目，只能看到身近极小范围，无法免疫。
- 传送法珠：所有人拥有受击闪现效果。

[h2]四大天王[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/bb140c8faf524602524ce977ac6932ce83449496.jpg[/img]
《上古记》：神族的“珈蓝天众”有四位头领，称为“珈蓝四大天王”。后来人们以他们的形象创造四大天王雕像，震慑邪魔。
[b]持国天王魔礼海[/b]，拥有神器碧玉琵琶，四首神曲掌握全场。魔礼海的靡音避无可避，防不胜防，心智弱者会被魅惑，心智坚定也会晕眩，不愧为四大天王的核心人物。
- 飞天曲，闻者如步云乘风，行走如飞。
- 破阵曲，点燃热血，力量倍增。
- 广安曲，镇定宁神，守御天下。
- 万钧曲，千斤加身，迟缓如老叟。
[b]增长天王魔礼青[/b]，力可开山裂地，手持神器青云剑，由神族名匠制作，任何灵甲都无法承受它一击。据古籍记载，魔礼青还会操控天剑，远程杀敌，斩杀妖魔无数。
[b]广目天王魔礼寿[/b]，魔力为四天王之首。魔礼寿手中的螭龙，是罕见的活体法器，它可帮助魔礼寿操控各种元素法术，不但能远程打击对手，还会制造各种异常状态。
[b]多闻天王魔礼红[/b]，拥有神器混元伞，收伞为枪，开伞成盾，可攻可守，还能控制引力场。混元伞的伞骨材料独特，任何灵甲在它面前也不堪一击。
如果成功击败四大天王，可以取得新秘宝：[b]【碧玉琵琶】[/b]和[b]【小螭龙】[/b]。

[h2]不破无诘[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/662687dbdc315a53219cc3938719b1f3cce06c26.jpg[/img]
《上古记》：神族天麓山，峰无数，其一峰名曰不破。不破峰上有无诘半神，手执破魔鞭，由神龙脊骨制成，丈八长，有雷电之力。无诘半神掌刑罚，铁面无情，对一切邪恶不予追问，直接用手中破魔鞭灭杀。
如果成功击败不破无诘，可以取得新兵器[b]【调教之鞭】[/b]。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/0ab178472523de4e324045cb09c6eeb9a00b9c2f.jpg[/img]

[h2]狂白仙[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/cd0bd32dc8c4c9410719a5d79e209fb12cca7593.jpg[/img]
《神的足迹》：白仙出现在天麓山，似乎在利用珈蓝天众磨练自己的武艺。只有疯子才会尝试这种修炼方法，而这时候的白仙，神智异常，真如疯子一样。白仙神智和身体的变化，一定源于天麓山某个秘密，但那到底是什么呢？
如果成功击败狂白仙，可以取得新秘宝[b]【天罡核】[/b]。

[h2]昆仑巫[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/4f7375e61cf8b71526f72fd09accedfc6fea6636.jpg[/img]
在天麓山的隐藏区域，你会遇到受伤的昆仑巫。交谈后得知她正在调查空间裂缝，曾经与入侵的恶魔战斗。如果你很好奇，她可以向你展示恶魔的强大。这一场战斗极为困难，能否在魔化的昆仑巫手下存活，得看各位斩妖人的实力。如果成功击败魔化昆仑巫，她将赠与你新秘宝：[b]一条狐狸尾巴[/b]？如果苏嫣在这里，一定会认得，这是[b]【糖糖】[/b]大表姐的尾巴！为什么会落在昆仑巫手中？
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/6c4b31dcb761dc3a859ef2a024ef1bb2cbf0ed4d.jpg[/img]

[h1]新角色：蓝霞[/h1]
当通关天麓山一次，即可以解锁新角色“蓝霞”。这位沉睡了几千年的“珈蓝之母”，终于被轮回社唤醒。早已失去一切希望的神族少女，迷茫的接过轮回社给她的武器，走入轮回试炼中。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/73c9fcf9649b7a26f84b962f86176aab98ca4155.jpg[/img]

[h2]蓝霞的双臂[/h2]
蓝霞在出生时就缺少双臂，对于追求完美的神族，这种天生缺陷是罪。神族科技发达，装上义肢的蓝霞在身体机能上不输于任何健全的族人，但她依然被族人嫌弃。在蓝霞无尽的寿命中，这一双缺失的手臂，成为她最大的心魔。

[h2]闪米特、含米特、珈蓝传承[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/9bec0483e1ed973201a6087c56f30a2f090bc6f7.jpg[/img]
蓝霞在神族时，原名含米特。与她一同出生的双胞胎哥哥名为闪米特。相比起残缺的妹妹，闪米特无论身体还是心智都极为完美，很快就成为神族耀眼的新星。闪米特痛爱妹妹，一直守护着她，让她免受其他族人欺凌。但躲在明星哥哥背后，含米特心中的阴影也越来越大。

珈蓝传承由闪米特一手策划，意在解决神族在这片大陆无法延续血脉的困境，神族高层对这个试验寄予厚望。闪米特原计划用自己为实验母体，这是极之冒险的举动，实验稍有偏差，实验母体可能受到无法逆转的伤害，甚至死亡。含米特抢先一步申请担任实验母体。这举动，一来为了保护哥哥；二来含米特越来越厌恶自己的存在，甚至于期待死亡。她觉得，为了哥哥的事业而牺牲，也挺好。得知真相的闪米特要求中止实验，但终无能为力。

如史料记载，珈蓝实验失败，仅仅创造出半成品的珈蓝天众。耗费巨大资源，换来对神族无足轻重的附庸种族，这让高层非常生气。闪米特的老师为了保护自己的学生，把实验失败归咎于实验母体——含米特。于是处于晕迷中的含米特，与废弃的珈蓝实验室，一起被遗弃在天麓山。内心充满对妹妹的内疚，闪米特给珈蓝天众下达守护天麓山指令，然后自己投身于上古大战前线。和所有没被记载的神族战士一样，闪米特战死在这片土地上。

[h2]全武精通与七项技能[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/9498ce3ef304bdbdc52a094c5bca8276530ca21d.jpg[/img]
* 蓝霞的义肢应用了神族神器术，能专精七系全部武器，对应七个技能，换武器时，技能自动切换。
  - 长刀-[b]圣光[/b]：消耗40魔力，持续30秒，移除和免疫盲目，暂时驱除夜幕，每秒为自己及友军回复2生命。
  - 长柄-[b]气场[/b]：消耗30魔力，持续30秒，以自身为中心向外产生推力，敌人很难靠近你。
  - 大锤-[b]地动[/b]：消耗30魔力，持续30秒，所有攻击都带有击倒效果。
  - 双持-[b]星辰[/b]：消耗10魔力，向目标射出一枚星辰飞镖，飞镖会在敌人之间弹射最多2次。星辰飞镖威力与施术者属性相关。
  - 盾刀-[b]飞兽[/b]：消耗30魔力，持续30秒，攻击命中血肉目标，会生成血咒蝙蝠。蝙蝠继承施法者属性伤害及50%攻击力。
  - 锁镰-[b]生灵[/b]：消耗30魔力，随机召唤一位友方珈蓝生灵，该生灵继承施法者攻击力及属性伤害。
  - 火铳-[b]安息[/b]：消耗20魔力，向目标射出一枚眩晕飞镖，被命中的目标眩晕5秒。

* 角色可以携带两把武器，所以技能与武器能一定程度上混搭，比如开启了长柄武器的气场后，使用锁镰或火铳这类远程武器，可以大大增加安全性。

* 蓝霞天赋涉及技能之间相互影响，强化技能组合效果。
  - [b]圣光普照[/b]：在圣光技能持续效果之下，飞兽及生灵技能召唤出来的生物，生命翻倍，攻击力增加30%。
  - [b]无尽星空[/b]：在气场技能持续效果之下，星辰技能的星辰飞镖弹射次数增加到4次，伤害增加50%。
  - [b]大地安息[/b]：在地动技能持续效果之下，安息技能的眩晕飞镖造成眩晕持续时间延长到30秒，伤害翻倍。

* 蓝霞的长生符与长生咒也会改变技能效果，产生更丰富的变化。
  - [b]创造木符[/b]：蓝霞的星辰飞镖不再弹射，而是依据弹射次数，连续向目标发射多枚飞镖。
  - [b]创造石符[/b]：蓝霞的飞兽技能变更为施展时直接召唤出一个雷震子，雷震子继承施法者属性伤害及50%攻击力。
  - [b]创造银符[/b]：蓝霞的圣光技能不再恢复生命，而是使施法者对敌伤害增加30%。
  - [b]创造金符[/b]：蓝霞的气场技能推力消失，范围内受影响的敌人动作变慢，攻击力下降30%。
  - [b]创造玉符[/b]：蓝霞的地动技能施放时，会额外产生一个震波，把附近敌人震退击倒，受影响的敌人30秒内受到伤害增加30%。
  - [b]长生咒-道碎虚空[/b]：使用技能后，根据技能消耗的魔力数量，提升百分比攻击力，持续30秒。效果可以叠加，但离开当前场景时消失。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/3814b4584825a31af1b0de71f127aef9bae8e67a.jpg[/img]
通过长生符和技能组合，能取得相当夸张的效果。相比起其他角色，蓝霞技能最复杂，可挖掘的地方更多。

[h1]神秘人的秘密[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/785dae81782f25f12b48cadf1cf11b08d8a69a05.jpg[/img]
你通过天麓山试炼，获得轮回社三位掌控者的认可，并见到了那本不可能再见到的人。然而这一切，让你越来越怀疑轮回试炼的目的。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/c64892f0345800b60b9485ecdad6339e52ac5274.jpg[/img]
当你破除神秘人的幻术，发现这恐怕只是阴谋的第一层面纱。你能从这个试炼中脱身而出吗？

新版本马上就要来，各位的刀，磨锋利了吗？

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/2990bb47511c70732652193f5173d25febc3a53a.jpg[/img]


[h1]# Balance[/h1]

- Rework the resurrection system, replacing the previous Jade Pendant and other mechanisms with Amulet of Resurrection that does not disappear after entering a new level.  Remove Voodoo Doll and Heartbroke Red.

- [b]Whitescorp[/b]: Longer attack sway.
- [b]Stinger Toad[/b]: Longer attack sway.
- [b]Gravity Elite[/b]: Modified force field to only affect units of the hostile camp, not friendly units.
- Reduce the frequency of boss rage burst.
- Reduce the frequency of boss counterattack.
- Bosses are more likely to be stunned by attacks with stun effects.
- [b]The Five Oddities - Flamespitter[/b]: Attacks add Guad Break effect.
- [b]Great Sandworm[/b]: HP is reduced; if there are still small sandworms, no more small sandworms will be created.
- [b]Atlas of the East[/b]: No longer enters Berserk when join other boss battles.
- [b]Sledgehammer Raksa[/b]: HP reduced; longer shove attack startup animation; use different attack patterns at different phrase.


[h1]# Balance (Easy difficulty)[/h1]

- Adjust the implementation of enemy attack power reduction in Easy Difficulty.
- The second chapters of Easy Difficulty no longer have Curses, Dangerous Areas and Rampage Bosses; the third, fourth and fifth chapters no longer have Rampage Bosses; the fifth and sixth chapters have reduced enemy HP.
- [b]General Nara[/b]: HP reduced, attack power reduced, no bleeding damage.
- [b]Skeletal Immortal[/b]: Will no longer cast blood whistle.
- [b]Eastern Depot Overseer[/b]: Will no longer counterattack.
- [b]Gray Immortal[/b]: Will not do jumping attacks, transformed without berserk.
- [b]Broodmother Nest[/b]: Reduces poison damage, in which the female spider will not lay eggs.
- [b]Anglerkun[/b]: No other monsters appear.
- [b]Leviathan[/b]: Reduces cold damage, no berserk in phrase 2.
- [b]Yellow Immortal[/b]: No whirlwind war cry.
- [b]Willow Immortal[/b]: Reduces poison damage and will not summon the Jade snake.
- [b]Bandit Leader[/b]: No breakthrough slahes, no berserk and no reinforcements.
- [b]Great Sandworm[/b]: No bleeding damage, no spawning.

- [b]Relief of a Ghost Head (Chapter 5)[/b]: Significantly reduces the electric damage of the projectile.
- [b]Iron Window (Chapter 5)[/b]: Damage reduced from 20 to 5.
- [b]Fallen Buddha[/b]: Only one palm will be released; significantly reduces the attack power and elemental damage of projectile.
- [b]Acalanatha[/b]: Significantly reduced electric damage.
- [b]White Immortal[/b]: Significantly reduced damage from charging slashes.
- [b]Sledgehammer Raksa[/b]: No longer summons followers.
- [b]Fox Immortal[/b]: Significantly reduced bleeding damage; only one clone will be summoned.
- [b]Spirit Hunter[/b]: No longer summon helpers.


[h1]# Balance (Normal difficulty)[/h1]

- [b]General Nara[/b]: HP reduced, attack power reduced, no bleeding damage.
- [b]Pachi[/b]: Spin attack can be Perfect Blocked.
- [b]Fallen Buddha[/b]: Slightly reduces the elemental damage of projectile.


[h1]# Balance (Demonic difficulty)[/h1]

- [b]Arboreal Maiden[/b]: Longer attack swing for stalking spikes.
- [b]Forest Devil[/b]: Longer attack swing for stalking spikes.


[h1]# Balance (Weapons and Relics)[/h1]

- [b]Free Jar[/b]: There is a chance to get a refund of all coins when purchasing items in regular shops. (Remove price increase effect)

[h1]# Balance (Soul Charms)[/h1]

- [b]Divine Fury (Silver)[/b]: While Byleth is in Berserk, for every enemy killed, attack +20% (up to +200%).
- [b]Divine Fury (Jade)[/b]: While Byleth is in Berserk, for each hit received, attack +30% (up to +300%).
- [b]Domain (Stone)[/b]: Effective range is changed from 6 to 8, and damage is modified from a fixed 5 points to 10% of attack power.
- [b]Domain (Silver)[/b]: Effective range is changed from 6 to 8.
- [b]Domain (Golden)[/b]: Effective range is changed from 6 to 8.
- [b]Domain (Jade)[/b]: Familiars gain Lifesteal as well as attribute gain.
- [b]Gravity Force (Jade)[/b]: Enemies affected by Kharoum's Attraction Spell are fragile and vulnerable, and thunderbolts fall within the gravitational range, which have 50 electric damage and inherit all elemental damage and 50% attack power from the caster.
- [b]Control (Jade)[/b]: Falling thunderbolts have 50 electric damage and inherit all elemental damage and 50% attack power from the caster.
- [b]Assassination (Golden)[/b]: If Xilvaron kills an enemy affected by Mass Stun within 5 sec, Mass Stun will be triggered again at no (No longer reduces the range of the skill in effect)
- [b]Assassination (Jade)[/b]: Clones inherit a percentage of the player's attributes.


[h1]# Experience[/h1]

- Adjusted the requirements for earning Soul Charms rewards. No longer requires that the current character has all talents unlocked and has upgraded Soul Idol once, only that any character has ever opened the Soul Idol screen to receive the Soul Charms reward when clearing game on Normal or Demonic difficulty.
- Adjusted the description of Luoyang Shovel.

- Traps such as Killer Vine created by Inner Demons are shown in a darker color to make it easier to distinguish them.


[h1]# Bug Fixes[/h1]

- Fix the problem that when different burning effects are stacked, an error may occur when leaving current room.
- Fixed the problem that characters may be knocked out of the room when they die, and then resurrected outside.
- Fix the problem that after blocking the Buddha's poison ball with shield, the blocking hitbox will be invalid for a short time and may be hit by the next poison ball immediately afterwards.
- Fixed the problem that Assassin appears when you open a secret room with Disenchantment Bead, and if you kill Assassin quickly and then run to the door, you will get stuck.

- Fixed an issue that could cause the game to crash.

- Fixed the problem that sound effects cannot be played properly under some special circumstances.
- [b]Feline Fist[/b]: Fixed the problem that the charging jump attack did not consume stamina correctly.
- Fixed the problem that some monsters cannot attack when they are blind.
- Fixed the problem that the dialogue option may get stuck when saving money.
- Fixed the problem that the indicator of current HP on boss HP bar is not in the right position when changing the resolution.


[h1]# UI[/h1]

- Add a special logo to the journey route selection screen for the more difficult replacement levels unlocked after clearing the game.
- Adjusted the process of difficulty selection screen at Master Shi.
- Added a icon after the dialogue option that triggers a battle.


[h1]# Localization[/h1]

- Russian Language support.
- Improve the translated text.


[h1]# Misc[/h1]

- Added "Add 100 coins" to the cheat menu in Free Mode.
- Added Master Thief to Devil Slaying Log.
- Fix some typos.

notes.title: v0.9.25 The old hunters, Toxic Mist & Talents
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/ff98eb2524b3a28d6a9711f76e171c857a3cc653.jpg[/img]

This update brings a brand new relic set that should be familiar to the old hunters, including 6 relics and 1 new item...to be thrown away.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/c8a94f7fcd12e687ba3dbdd1a8bab6dad9ca201a.jpg[/img]

Aside from that, we overhauled some content to provide you new feelings: heard feedbacks about character talents and weapons not distinctive enough, several talents now have new passive effect on certain characters, while high tier posion weapons eventually got new moveset properties after the fire ones!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/d6cf8e64290e2a412ccb7cdb7ef8bc77e7bef3fd.gif[/img]

Another common complain is that enemies attack too fast, especially for new players. We slow down the attack foreswing of series of foes, you also get a tiny reminder when they spot the heroine and a bit more breathing space before their engaging. Well, if you consider it too easy & slow, try Demonic difficulty and trial tokens!
Much more changes & fixes are listed below, some of them not being highlighted but no minor, are likely to impact your run strategy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/8c7425bbc944ad877e65b25b84f2e16b23b0ac21.png[/img]
Finally, by our artist 不动明王(Acalanatha, oh yeah that's also the name of a Boss), all eneimes' portrait in the Bestiary! You can find more details from this new angle. Want more of not only monsters, but our heroines and npcs? Then you shall know we're preparing for the artbook DLC.

Aftering times of (official) leaks in the community, the new Chapter is coming, and we're not that far from 1.0! 

Let us know what you think on Steam Community & Discord!

[h1]# New Relics[/h1]

-[b] Hunter's Bell[/b]: When entering a boss area without a companion, summons one.
- [b]Executioner Attire[/b]: Heavy clothing that sacrifices agility for strength. -6 Movement Speed, +50% attack power while Stamina is full.
- [b]Monster Blood Pill[/b]: Upon entering a new area, +50% attack power for 2 minutes, then begin to lose HP every second until. It stops at 1 HP, and now you suffer a decreasing of 30% attack power.
- [b]Blood Wine[/b]: Grants Super Armor, +50% attack power, your attack could damage allies.
- [b]Music Box[/b]: Calm enemies down. Enemies won't enrage. You still get bouns reward for beating rampaged bosses.
- [b]Elden Ring[/b]: When receiving lethal damage, consume 10 soul to survive with 1 HP and remove all status effects. One use per chapter, won't active if current soul is below 10.

- [b]Hunter set[/b]: Grants immunity to immobilize & speed reductions. Increase Stimulant duration by 30s. Spawn pebbles on map frequently.
- [b]Pebble[/b]: Toss at the enemies. Just pick it up for further use as long as it's not shattered.


[h1]# Weapons[/h1]

- [b]Kunai[/b]: Doing "Crescent Slash" instead when charged R2 attack with no knife charges.
- [b]Withering Claws[/b]: Dodge with it will now release a cloud of toxic mist that deals 20 poison damage and blinds enemies for 10s. (Cooldown: 5s)
- [b]Serpent Sting[/b]: Charging Stab now release a cloud of toxic mist that deals 20 poison damage and blinds enemies for 10s.
- Charging attacks can now be held for up to 4s after full charge, giving player more flexible timing.


[h1]# Better Talents[/h1]

- [Byleth] [b]Divine Revival[/b]: Start a run with a single-use divine soul jade that can resurrect her immediately with 30% HP. (deactive after using Zombifying Pill)
- [Byleth] [b]Life Potion[/b]: Start a run with 1 free Life Potion. +50% effectiveness of Life Potion & Vitality Orb.
- [Ajiela] [b]High-tier Demon[/b]: Immune to possession, allies get +30% attack power.
- [Ajiela] [b]Magic Potion[/b]: Start a run with 1 free Magic Potion. Using magic potion also grants character 5s of invincibility.
- [Ralciel] [b]Defensive Counter[/b]: Successful blocks +20% damage deal to enemy for 2s; Successful perfect parry +50% damage deal to enemy for 2s.
- [Kharoum & Ralciel] [b]Wealth[/b]: Start a run with 20 coins. +50% attack while carrying 100 coins or more.


[h1]# Major Adjustments[/h1]

- Player characters gain innate status resistances in Easy difficulty. These resistances from different sources can be stacked.
- Suspend following token effects in shops & armories: Righteous Fury, Assassins, Time Fiend.
- Triggering death protection (Like a Cockroach, Elden Ring, Divine Soul Jade) will push enemies away and remove negative effects.
- Confused status now affects all dodge, move and attack directions.
- Silver Assassination soul charm skill effect now also inflicts elemental damage.
- Negative effects on companions will all be removed upon changing area.
- Improve companion AI so that they'll fight against enemies(summoned by tokens) before joining player's team.
- "Refine Soul Charms" option will be available to all character after any character unlocking it.
- Full new bestiary arts in the Monster Scroll!
- Enemies now have a 0.5s act delay after spotting player character.
- Slightly increase foreswing of some enemies' attacks (including Skeleton soldiers, Devil Slayers, Jianzhou/Firearms Division soldiers, Cat Devil, King of Thieves and Soldier Maid).
- Delay the shockwave of enrage enemies by 1s.
- You can now duplicate your profile in-game.


[h1]# Other Adjustments[/h1]

- Translation updates and improvemets.
- Added book "Notes on Arts of the Ninja".
- Improve transitions of dual blades/twin arms moveset.
- Winning in the challenge room and survival challenge will immediately cease any harmful objects in the area.
- Added death protection VFX (Like a Cockroach, Elden Ring, Divine Soul Jade); remake VFX of enrage shockware (Bosses, revive, catgirl transform)
- The fireball of All-seeing Heavenly King now illuminates around.
- Token thunders now illuminates around.
- Burning units now illuminates around.
- Ancient Flame Spirit, Animated Incense Burner and thier related effects now illuminates around.
- Flaming Shoes' fire trail now illuminates around.
- Changed Darksteel Sword's smash attack SFX.
- Changed Spirit Hunter's death SFX.
- Bonfires no longer affect flying units.
- Added display set collection state in the pickup screen.
- Added scrolling to some Devil Slaying logs.
- Adjustments to the  of Soul Crystals.

- Fixed Sage Ring's logic, now it deals a bit more damage.
- Fixed the cannon attack won't trigger Combo Knives effect.
- Fixed several dialogues when picking up weapons.
- Fixed the portal pushes items on ground cause them rotating to wrong dirctions.
- Fixed errors caused by force closing the game under specific circumstances.
- Fixed a problem that picking up new weapon in the cat girl state did not fail the "Stay True" achievement.
- Fixed a possible error in the battle of the demon of the heart.
- Fixed a error in the last Soul Room of Chinese New Year version.

notes.title: Upcoming Updates And Price Adjustment Announcement
notes.content:
Hello everyone, here is the latest inside information from the Pavilion of Spirits. Please read it carefully and do not let enemies know. 

[h2]UPCOMING UPDATES[/h2]

[h3]1. Difficulty Setting[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/5ec7db3424930e67a4956cfb554fbb77423bf79d.jpg[/img]
Expect the normal difficulty level, We provide” Easy Mode” and “Shura Mode (Hell Mode)” now. You can switch them anytime and have no need to build a new save file.

The enemies will be weaker in “Easy Mode”. So if you think the game is too hard for you, just try it. When you're familiar with combat skills, then switch to another difficulty level.

In terms of the “Shura Mode”, the enemies will be much stronger than before. Besides, more than 10 new enemies will appear, giving you a harder challenge.

[h3]2. Trial Token System[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/4efc368b9de1de8cf67c78db7a7bb31884add39f.jpg[/img]
Old Shi, who holds the Reincarnation Trials, is creating a Trial Token System. Every Trial Token stands for a form of the trail world. It will bring you some new experience and opportunities. You can switch on and off each Trial Token all by yourself to make the rules.

[h3]3. Soul Idol, Soul Charm, and Soul Spell[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/3938c523e2cb60218f33ca052109d7a11d5b5458.jpg[/img]
Raven made Soul Idol to every challenger. You can install the Soul Charms on it, which obtained during the journey. Every Soul Charm has a special effect, some of them can even change the character’s skill. When you combine specific Soul Charms, Soul Spell will be activated. So use it to custom your own character. 

[h3]4. The Seventh Test Site[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/12da6fa1f5c6c804eac45c099adf3f083f79db03.jpg[/img]
When you are strong enough, the Mysterious Person will invite you to The Seventh Test Site. No one is said to have successfully returned from there. What will you find over there? 

[h3]5. 8 New Bosses Is Coming[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/6d45566661a29f4222d204e3dc80b0639aa4de51.jpg[/img]
Some players said this game is too easy for them, right? 8 new bosses are waiting for you, with a KIND smile. 

[h3]6. 40 New Relics[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/0134b0cbed95dc529cc96f7ed37363728c0959a4.jpg[/img]
You will find 40 new relics in this update, which will bring you some new styles of gameplay. You will love them, I promise. 

[h3]7. New Character And New Weapons[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/30df70a82c5a1dc5af8245027cc5bfb3e3a56035.jpg[/img]
The Mysterious Person brings another girl to the Pavilion of Spirits. Who is she? What is the story behind her? What kind of new weapon will you meet in her journey?

[h3]8. Challenge Mode[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/4ea76339b7969a4423453359f198d89cd478c982.jpg[/img]
Yi Xue will open the entrance to the challenge space. This is a short, fast-paced, but exceptionally difficult challenge for you. Are you ready? Probably die a thousand times is very common in it.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/70bf8a8825824c1ab9dfb79d7e412277bff57bc1.jpg[/img]

( Some of the game text is still under translation. We will release a patch as soon as it is completed. )


[h1]# How to access the test branch[/h1]
- Right-clicking on 'Devil Slayer - Raksasi' in your Steam library.
- Click ‘Properties’.
- Click the 'Betas' tab.
- Select 'test' from the drop-down menu.
- Click 'Close'.


[h1]# New Contents (Bosses)[/h1]
- [b]Wolf and raccoon[/b]: The two demons, known as the Two Immortals of Wind and Lightning, appear in the desert.


[h1]# New Contents (Relics)[/h1]
- [b]Thundraka Belly Drum[/b]: Attacks against monsters will generate lightning bolts that strike your foes. This effect can trigger up to 3 times per room.
- [b]Glasses Cat's Bell[/b]: Redesigned to have the effect of transforming into a cat girl and performing a mysterious cat martial arts. Restores to the original form when your HP drops to 0. Can be used once per chapter.


[h1]# New Feature[/h1]
- [b]Train[/b]: Add train option "Rampage Bosses".
- [b]Controller Settings[/b]: Add an option to switch on/off the function of using the right stick for locking targets.
- [b]Graphic Settings[/b]: Add an option to switch on/off the blur effect.


[h1]# Balance (Player)[/h1]
- All effects that change the "Stamina Recovery" by percentage are changed to by fixed values.


[h1]# Balance (Weapons)[/h1]
- [b]Infernal Smasher[/b]: Slam now triggers "Dust to Dust" effect; Splintering Strike now triggers "Dust to Dust" and "Burning Ground" effect.
- [b]Crimson Lotus[/b]: Pierce now triggers "Dust to Dust" effect.
- [b]Darksteel Gauntlets[/b]: Six-Combo Fist now has "Super Armor" effect, its damage factor changes from 1 to 1.3, and now has blocking hitboxes.
- [b]Magma Sword & Obsidian Shield[/b]: the second move of Shield Bash now triggers "Dust to Dust" effect.


[h1]# Balance (Relics & Sets)[/h1]
- [b]Purchase Order[/b]: Now belongs to Jackpot Set.
- [b]Glasses Cat's Necklace[/b]: its effect is changed to have a chance of resurrection when you die. Your Max HP is no longer changed on resurrection.
- [b]Mouse Spirit[/b]: The number of souls required to unlock has been changed to 30.
- [b]Puppet Maggot[/b]: The number of souls required to unlock has been changed to 30.
- [b]Panacea Set[/b]: Health Potion and Regenerate apply to both the user and all companions.


[h1]# Balance (Bosses)[/h1]
- [b]Crazed Magistrate[/b]: Do not continue summoning after 5 summons in total.
- [b]The Five Oddities[/b]: Do not continue summoning after 10 summons in total.
- [b]Pachi[/b]: Add a self-destruct warning for summoned nightmare worms.
- [b]Broodmother[/b]: Add a self-destruct warning.
- [b]Gelatinous Abomination[/b]: Add self-destruct warnings for it and its summons.
- [b]Bandit Leader[/b]: Modify the barrier area.
- [b]White Immortal[/b]: Slightly reduce the duration of the back swing of its dash attacks.
- [b]Fox Immortal[/b]: The damage of its projectiles are slightly increased, and are affected by the damage penetration.
- [b]Arrested Spirit[/b]: The damage of its projectiles are slightly increased, and are affected by the damage penetration.


[h1]# Balance (Monsters)[/h1]
- [b]Zombie Artisan[/b]: Do not continue summoning after 3 summons in total.
- [b]Spider Eggsac[/b]: Add a self-destruct warning.
- [b]Kamikaze Puffer[/b]: Add a self-destruct warning.
- [b]Jade[/b]: Immune to Poison damage.
- [b]Bandit Snatcher[/b]: The cast ropes are modified to only have control effects, but no damage.
- [b]Desert Viper[/b]: Immune to Poison damage.
- [b]Ancient Flame Spirit[/b]: Add a self-destruct warning.


[h1]# Balance (Environments)[/h1]
- [b]Bonfire[/b]: Can illuminate a radius of 5 when the field of view is affected by "Nightfall" or "Thick Fog".
- [b]Exploding Shroom[/b]: Add a self-destruct warning.
- [b]Wall of Blades[/b]: Changes its damage from 10 to 30.


[h1]# Balance (Misc)[/h1]
- Increase "Damage Penetration" by 50% for all level 6 enemies.
- Burning no longer removes the effects of Slow caused by Frost damage.


[h1]# Experience Optimization[/h1]
- [b]Crazed Magistrate[/b]: Assistant to Crazed Magistrate's ability to heal is now in the form of a projectile. Defeating it earns you "Scroll (Puppet Maggot)".
- [b]General Nara[/b]: Modify the get up action at the start of the second phase so that it cannot be hit.
- [b]Long-legged Spider[/b]: Adjusts attachment animation and attachment position.
- [b]Apparition[/b]: Adjusts attachment animation and attachment position.
- [b]Tiny Sandworm[/b]: Add to “Devil Slaying Log”.
- [b]Bandit Rider[/b]: add invincibility frames to the stand up action.
- [b]Coupon[/b]: Update product price immediately when acquired in shop.
- [b]Glasses Cat Set[/b]: Change the summoned small white cat to a small orange cat.
- Improve the hints for newbies; add hints for running and teleporting.
- Add a protection mechanism to prevent the player from being killed by enemy's high damage attacks when they still have a lot of life left.
- Adjusted the way the player's attributes are displayed.
- Enemies that do not prevent the player from leaving the room will no longer be randomly replaced with other types of enemies.


[h1]# User Interface[/h1]
- Add several background animations of different characters for the game start menu.
- Adjust the layout of the pause menu interface.
- Now the number of Buffs stacked will be displayed.
- Solve the problem that multi-language support is not properly implemented in the button setting interface.
- Fix the problem that the weapon icon crosses over the border in the practice mode weapon selection interface.
- Set the number of teleportation displayed in the main interface to "∞".


[h1]# Effects[/h1]
- Runs in the water will not generate smoke.
- When the Lantern Keeper disappears after making a deal, a teleport effect will be played.
- When an attack triggers "Smash" effect, a corresponding effect will be displayed.


[h1]# Bug Fixes[/h1]
- Fix an issue where attribute values could be displayed in decimal form in the pause menu.
- Fix an issue where Guiding Herb did not take effect on Health Potion. Modify the description of Bracers of Darkness and Guiding Herb using a more accurate way to describe it.
- Fix an issue where "Fists of Momentum" could be both active and cooldown at the same time.
- Fix an issue that after picking up "Familiar's Heart" and "Spirit Seal" one after the other, familiars will grow and then shrink.
- Fixed the problem that the Cluster Mine don't disappear immediately when it explode.
- Fix a problem that the control effect from the bandits won't be removed when you resurrect.
- Fix a bug that the victory reward chest is missing in “t08_normal_06” scene of Desert Level.
- Fix a bug that the invincibility of monster appearance animations sometimes doesn't work.
- Fix an issue where the summoned creatures of the Arboreal Maiden still survived after the Arboreal Maiden was defeated.
- Fix a bug that some random states are not saved correctly.
- Fix a bug that some hit effects don't display on the right layer.
- Fix a bug that flying enemies can't move across low barriers.
- Fix a problem with the underlying random function.


[h1]# Localization[/h1]
- Resolve the problem of some Japanese text crossing over the frame.
- Solve the problem of text overlap in some interfaces.
- Improve the multi-language support in Freemode console interface.
- Fix some text translation problems.
- Import the latest translated text.


[h1]# Misc[/h1]
- Improve the weapon's description information for Guard Break, Smash, Knockdown, and other traits.
- Change the texturing settings for the background animation of the title screen and the leader's appearance animation to improve the display quality.
- Modify the text of the book on Lery's request.
- Fix the inconsistency between Ralciel's background description and skill description.
- Adjust the presentation of some Chinese text.
- Fix some typos.

- [b]New Weapon[/b]: Double Bladed Staff
  * The corresponding scroll can be obtained by beating Final Bosses.

  * Can be unlocked from the Old Crone. [King of Thieves] must be unlocked first.
  * Once unlocked, it will appear in Chapter 6.

[h1]# New Feature[/h1]

- Support custom mouse buttons remapping.


[h1]# Balance[/h1]

- [b]Japhriel[/b]: Redo the Slow spell, change it from single trigger effect to continuous trigger effect, display its lasting timing; The Slow spell also reduces enemies' action speed now.
- [b]Tindra[/b]: Strategic Bomb's MP cost changed to 25.
- [b]Khopesh[/b]: Base attack damage increased to 25.
- [b]Magic Power Set[/b]: MP can only be restored by killing enemies of flesh and blood.
- [b]Miasma[/b]: Removed from the game temporarily.
- [b]Arboreal Maiden[/b]: The range and frequency of the poison shooting increased, and the HP of Thorns increased.
- [b]Centipede[/b]: Attacks can be launched from underground.
- [b]Hornet's Nest[/b]: Immune to all status effects.
- [b]Puppet Maggot[/b]: The effect of controlling monsters disappears after 30 seconds.
- [b]Centipede[/b]: Move speed increase to 30 after going underground.
- [b]Kamikaze Puffer[/b]: Death explosions now have guard-break effect.
- [b]Crescent Blade[/b]: Shorten the startup animation of swing attacks. Increase hitbox size.
- [b]Lava Blood[/b]: The effect of the relic is modified to give you an effect of increasing Fire Damage by 20 points (up to 200 points) each time you receive damage exceeding 10 points. The effect disappears when you leave the current room.
- [b]Poisoned Blood[/b]: The effect of the relic is modified to give you an effect of increasing Poison Damage by 20 points (up to 200 points) each time you receive damage exceeding 10 points. The effect disappears when you leave the current room.
- [b]Tome of Mastery[/b]: +5 seconds cooldown.
- [b]Blood Shield[/b]: Move from the store item pool to the BOSS item pool.
- [b]Eye Devourer's Pupil[/b]: Move from the BOSS item pool to the store item pool.
- [b]Health Potion[/b]: Add the effect of removing all abnormal states.
- [b]Magic Potion[/b]: Add the effect of removing all abnormal states.
- [b]Panacea Set[/b]: The effect is modified to increase Max HP by 100 points, Health Potion and Regenerate are effective on both the wearer and all familiars.
- [b]Gelatinous Abomination[/b]: Add the effect of guard-break to the self explosion at death.
- [b]The Steadfast King[/b]: Berserk lightning strikes now have the ability to break guard.
- [b]Momentum Set[/b]: gain Spirit Armor only when killing an enemy with a Soul bonus.
- [b]Mire Battalion[/b]: Soul bonus changed from 4 to 0.
- [b]Mire Squad[/b]: Soul bonus changed from 0 to 1.
- [b]Broodmother[/b]: Add the effect of guard-break to the self explosion at death.
- All sledgehammer weapons now have the ability to increase the target's recovery time after been hit by 0.4 seconds.


[h1]# Experience[/h1]

- If the treasure box is opened in a crowded place (such as the corners in Skeletal Immortal BOSS fight), it will disappear after opening to avoid blocking the player.
- The skill icon now shows how many times the skill can be used in its current state.
- When the  Demented Carter is killed, the sound of the cart will end.
- Improve the key binding function, support directly exchange key-1 and key-2 of the same function.
- Modify some game text for unified expression.
- Avoid the problem of excessive volume caused by volume superposition when continuously playing the same sound effects.
- Remove the fire traps in the entrance position of some rooms in Chapter 5.
- Adjust the speech bubble texts of the Wooden Man in the Pavilion of Spirits according to 修奇's suggestion.
- Increase the player's movement speed slightly when there are no monsters nearby.
- Refine the monster's impact teleportation effect.
- Refine the logic of the charm effect.
- Refine the effect of the force fields to avoid situations where the gravitational force changes with position incorrectly.
- [b]Kharoum[/b]: Add triggered speech when meeting Yijia Zhang.
- [b]Japhriel[/b]: Improve the shoulder texture.
- [b]Disastoise[/b]: Adjust the sound effect configuration to avoid the problem of continuing to play rotating sound effects even after death.
- [b]Train Mode[/b]: After killing an enemy, add a little time interval before respawning the next enemy.
- [b]Crazed Magistrate[/b]: Drops [Scroll - Puppet Maggot].
- [b]The Five Oddities[/b]: Drops [Scroll - Golden Silkworm].
- [b]General Nara[/b]: Drops [Scroll - Fists of Momentum].
- [b]Miserly Demon (Achievement)[/b]: The requirement has been changed from "do not purchase goods" to "do not spend money".


[h1]# UI[/h1]

- Change some text names of resources such as coins, dark gold, souls, and keys to icons.
- Solve the problem that the item switching prompt UI is not updated immediately after consuming the current item.
- Achievement status icons are now only displayed during the adventure. No longer displayed in Pavilion of Spirits and Practice Mode.
- Corresponding icons of some achievements are now displayed on the summary UI.
- Talent information now can be viewed in the character selection UI.
- Adjust the order of items of Heroic Deeds in the Devil Slayer Log.
- Refactor the settings UI to enhance ease of use or expandability. Add the option to open the Wiki site.
- Display the difficulty in the save data selection UI to prepare for difficulty selections.
- When there are no valid killers, hides the killers information from the death screen.


[h1]# SFX[/h1]

- Add air distortion effect for some shock waves.
- Add soul absorbing effects when picking up a Soul Orb.
- Adjust the effect detail of the soul absorbing effect.
- Fine-tune the effect of the  portals.
- Add a teleportation effect.
- Weaken some of the airwave effects.
- Add air distortion effect to portals.
- Adjust the air distortion effect of shockwaves.


[h1]# Bug Fixes[/h1]

- [b]Japhriel[/b]: Fix the startup duration of her animation of Sickle & Chain.
- [b] Shockbands[/b]: Fix an issue where some attack methods of specific weapons (such as the slashing attack of the "Sword & Shield") could not stun.
- [b]Heartbroke Red[/b]: Fix an issue where the item set information was displayed incorrectly after it was consumed.
- [b]Void Body Status[/b]: Change the implementation using "Avoid all damage". When in the Void Body state, it will no longer continue to receive damage caused by continuous effects such as the burning and poisoning effect before adding the Void Body state.
- [b]Skeletal Immortal[/b]: Flying skulls have been corrected to non-flesh-and-blood units.
-[b] Arboreal Maiden[/b]: Fix an issue where she might be pushed to the wrong position.
- [b]The Steadfast King[/b]: Solve the problem that The Steadfast King did not play the hit animation correctly after receiving a guard-break attack.
- [b]Assassination Duo[/b]: Solve the problem that the game mechanics that they will keep respawning unless you kill them all may not take effect.
- [b]Farmer Bandit Leader[/b]: Fix an issue where subsequent attacks could not be properly connected after grabbing the opponent.
- [b]Wushu Monk[/b]: Fix the problem that the Wushu Monk cannot be knocked down.
- [b]Centipede[/b]: Automatically pop up when losing the target, avoiding the problem that it keeps underground when controlled by the Puppet Maggot and cannot be killed.
- Fix an issue where sound may not play correctly when playing remotely with Steam Remote Play.
- Fix an issue where chain attacks could not be used correctly when an Iaido Blade used by AI units.
- Corrected the display layer of effects such as effects of lightning damage, and fixed the problem that the lightning damage effect was not displayed immediately after the Rosethorn Maiden was teleported when receiving attack with lightning damage.
- [b]Xilvaron[/b]: Revising the inaccurate talent description of the "Sneak Attack" and "The Killing Blow".
- [b]Zanbatou[/b]: Remove the description of unable to parry in the description text.
- [b]Flamebrand[/b]: Remove the description of unable to parry in the description text.
- [b]Blunderbusses[/b]: Fix the problem that the charging attack does not cause stun.
- [b]Tome of Mastery[/b]: Fix an issue that there is a chance to push enemies into gaps of barrier areas.
- Fix issues that the effects such as shockwaves and smokes occurring outside of the screen would be delayed until they entered the screen.
- Fix an issue the setting options such as mouse size could not be saved.
- [b]Bandit Leader Executioner[/b]: Fix an issue of not being able to do charging attacks.
- [b]Zanbatou - Challenger[/b]: Fix an issue of not being able to do charging attacks.
- [b]Train Mode[/b]: Fixes an issue where debug information is not displayed correctly at the bottom of the screen.
- Fix an issue where there were two stones stacked in a scene in Chapter 6.
- Fix an issue that achievements could be unlocked in Practice Mode.
- Fix an issue that error could occur when a specific achievement unlock popup window was triggered in a place other than the Pavilion of Spirits.
- Fix some button remapping problems.
- Fix an issue where special dialogue text could cause the game to freeze.
- Fix some typos.
- Fix the problem where some monsters' bleeding attack doesn't take effect.
- Fix the issue that the routes selection screen may display abnormally at some resolutions.
- Fix an error caused by changing the display resolution.
- Fix a texture order problem in the Soul Room of Great Wall level.
- Fix an underlying system error that could cause the program to crash.
- Fix a problem where the probability of adding a buff may be handled incorrectly.
- Fix the problem that the burn effect does not continue to damage collided targets after entering another room.
- Fix an issue where monsters continued to spawn after the BOSS being defeated.
- Fix the issue that the game options are not saved properly.
- Fix a problem that the character moves at an abnormal speed after an accidental program crash when the character is running under certain conditions.
- Fix the problem that the Cursed Blood Bat not being able to move pass the low barriers.


[h1]# Localization[/h1]

- If there is no corresponding translated text, the Chinese will be displayed by default instead of leaving it blank, which makes it easier to spot missing translation issues.
- Updated description of MP cost of Strategic Bomb in the translated text.
- Adjust some translation text to avoid display problems.
- Fixed missing English and Japanese translations of Power Belt, Sprint Shoes, Fists of Momentum, Earthshaker.
- Update translated text.
- [b]Mysterious Merchant Baldwyn[/b]: Improving the English translation of bubble dialogue text.
- Update the translated text.
- Improve the translated text.


[h1]# Misc[/h1]
- Correct some typos.
- Other minor optimizations and adjustments.

notes.content:

# How to access the test branch

- Right-clicking on 'Devil Slayer - Raksasi' in your Steam library.
- Click ‘Properties’.
- Click the 'Betas' tab.
- Select 'test' from the drop-down menu.
- Click 'Close'.


# New Contents

- New Weapon: Sleeve Bone Needle
  * Corresponding scroll can be obtained from challenge rooms in level 4 or 5.
  * Corresponding scroll can also be obtained from Survival Challenges, Final BOSS or other places.

- Scavenging Merchant
  * Can be unlocked from the Old Crone. [King of Thieves] must be unlocked first.
  * Once unlocked, it will appear in Chapter 6.
  * You can purchase Relics from Scavenging Merchant using Souls.


# New Feature

- Support custom mouse buttons remapping.


# Balance

- Japhriel: Redo the Slow spell, change it from single trigger effect to continuous trigger effect, display its lasting timing; The Slow spell also reduces enemies' action speed now.
- Tindra: Strategic Bomb's MP cost changed to 25.
- Khopesh: Base attack damage increased to 25.
- Magic Power Set: MP can only be restored by killing enemies of flesh and blood.
- Miasma: Removed from the game temporarily.
- Arboreal Maiden: The range and frequency of the poison shooting increased, and the HP of Thorns increased.
- Centipede: Attacks can be launched from underground.
- Hornet's Nest: Immune to all status effects.


# Experience

- If the treasure box is opened in a crowded place (such as the corners in Skeletal Immortal BOSS fight), it will disappear after opening to avoid blocking the player.
- The skill icon now shows how many times the skill can be used in its current state.
- When the  Demented Carter is killed, the sound of the cart will end.
- Improve the key binding function, support directly exchange key-1 and key-2 of the same function.
- Modify some game text for unified expression.
- Avoid the problem of excessive volume caused by volume superposition when continuously playing the same sound effects.
- Remove the fire traps in the entrance position of some rooms in Chapter 5.


# UI

- Change some text names of resources such as coins, dark gold, souls, and keys to icons.
- Solve the problem that the item switching prompt UI is not updated immediately after consuming the current item.
- Achievement status icons are now only displayed during the adventure. No longer displayed in Pavilion of Spirits and Practice Mode.
- Corresponding icons of some achievements are now displayed on the summary UI.
- Talent information now can be viewed in the character selection UI.
- Adjust the order of items of Heroic Deeds in the Devil Slayer Log.


# SFX

- Add air distortion effect for some shock waves.
- Add soul absorbing effects when picking up a Soul Orb.
- Adjust the effect detail of the soul absorbing effect.


# Bug Fixes

- Japhriel: Fix the startup duration of her animation of Sickle & Chain.
- Shockbands: Fix an issue where some attack methods of specific weapons (such as the slashing attack of the "Sword & Shield") could not stun.
- Heartbroke Red: Fix an issue where the item set information was displayed incorrectly after it was consumed.
- Void Body Status: Change the implementation using "Avoid all damage". When in the Void Body state, it will no longer continue to receive damage caused by continuous effects such as the burning and poisoning effect before adding the Void Body state.
- Skeletal Immortal: Flying skulls have been corrected to non-flesh-and-blood units.
- Arboreal Maiden: Fix an issue where she might be pushed to the wrong position.
- The Steadfast King: Solve the problem that The Steadfast King did not play the hit animation correctly after receiving a guard-break attack.
- Assassination Duo: Solve the problem that the game mechanics that they will keep respawning unless you kill them all may not take effect.
- Farmer Bandit Leader: Fix an issue where subsequent attacks could not be properly connected after grabbing the opponent.
- Wushu Monk: Fix the problem that the Wushu Monk cannot be knocked down.
- Fix an issue where sound may not play correctly when playing remotely with Steam Remote Play.
- Fix an issue where chain attacks could not be used correctly when an Iaido Blade used by AI units.
- Corrected the display layer of effects such as effects of lightning damage, and fixed the problem that the lightning damage effect was not displayed immediately after the Rosethorn Maiden was teleported when receiving attack with lightning damage.
- Fix an issue where there were two stones stacked in a scene in Chapter 6.
- Fix an issue that achievements could be unlocked in Practice Mode.
- Fix an issue that error could occur when a specific achievement unlock popup window was triggered in a place other than the Pavilion of Spirits.
- Fix some button remapping problems.
- Fix an issue where special dialogue text could cause the game to freeze.
- Fix some typos.


# Localization

- Updated description of MP cost of Strategic Bomb in the translated text.
- Adjust some translation text to avoid display problems.

- Update translated text.

notes.title: Patch notes v0.9.9 (test branch)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/2990bb47511c70732652193f5173d25febc3a53a.jpg[/img]


# New Content

- Bomb Spirit: Belongs to the Beastmaster Set. No scroll required.


# Balance

- Longswords: Increase the size of damage checking boxes.
- Sledgehammers: Add blocking box to the handle of sledgehammers in swing actions.
- Shield & Blades: Increase the startup speed of slash attacks. Increase the size of blades' damage checking boxes.
- Sickle & Chains: Increase the size of throwing weapons' damage checking boxes.
- Pill of Marching: Now belongs to the Practitioner Set. Its price will rise like relics.
- Carrion Maggot Nest: Immune to the Puppet Maggot.
- Skeleton Pit: Immune to the Puppet Maggot.
- Grass Spirit: Immune to the Puppet Maggot.
- Spiral Dragon Tower: Immune to the Puppet Maggot.
- All-hearing God King: attacking action adjusted.
- White Immortal: Increase the tracking time of his charged attack.
- All characters with "Immune all negative effects" now also immune to root effects.


# Experience

- Change the dodging control method to the old way: immediately trigger dodge when the dodge key is press down. Add an option to enable the "No dodge before sprint" way.
- Add an option in "System Settings" to allow the application to run in the background.
- Add a black edge to coins to enhance recognition in bright scenes.
- Improve the handling of guarding and guard-breaking mechanism. Prevent enemies from keeping guard positions after taking guard-break attacks.
- Prevent UI elements from overlapping in the weapon gaining UI.
- Add an entrance to the Credits in the "Developers" UI.
- Improved Credits UI: supports pause, change scroll speed and skip.
- Set several different poison BUFF as mutually exclusive to avoid obtaining multiple poison BUFF at the same time.
- Adjust the period of time during which character dodge actions are allowed to be canceled.
- When returning to the Pavilion of Spirits from the training mode, respawn the heroine near Yi Xue.
- Add display of the kill count and the resurrection count.
- Display icons corresponding to several states such as no weapons change, no purchase, no damage, etc., which is convenient to observe whether it is in a state where the corresponding achievements can be completed.
- Adjust weapon information displayed in HUD UI.
- Now you can pass the Soul Gate even when you holding unexpended souls, only if you have already unlocked all traits and talents from Old Crone and Raven.


# Bug Fixes

- Fix an issue where switching rooms back and forth could avoid being harmed by poison BUFF.
- Fix the problem that the interval trigger of the BUFF mechanism sometimes triggered one fewer times.
- Fix an issue where Tomb Guardian will disappear if you activate it and leave the room.
- Fix an issue where the Blade Shield and the Demon Slayer's shield combo action encountered in the Challenge Room was incorrectly configured and unable to defend.
- Fix the action problems of enemy blade&shield devil slayers that they performed wrong shield bash attacks and were unable to raise the shield for defense.
- Fix an action offset issue when the snake-shaped enemies get rooted and unable to move.
- Fix the problem that sound effects are lost when some actions are connected.
- Fix the problem that the option selecting of training mode is working incorrectly.
- Fix a sound error of Byleth's shield & blade weapon.
- Fix the hitbox of Byleth's sickle & chain weapon.
- Fix an issue where the heroine might not be able to enter the windy room in chapter 6 when move speed is too low.
- Fix an issue where the music on the title screen would not play properly when returning to the title screen from the state where the music stopped after defeating a BOSS.
- Fix the name of the Earthshaker BUFF.
- Fix the inconsistency of the English name of Hsing T'ien.
- Fix an issue where a scrooge in the great wall chapter cannot be interacted with.
- Correct typos in manuscripts.
- Fix related books and hint text for the slow effect.

- Fix an issue where the reward of the last fight in Survive Challenge would have a high probability of being non-relic items.
