notes.title: Patch notes v0.9.5 (test branch)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710785/2990bb47511c70732652193f5173d25febc3a53a.jpg[/img]


# How to access the test branch

- right-clicking on 'Devil Slayer - Raksasi' in your Steam library.
- clicking ‘Properties’.
- clicking on the 'Betas' tab.
- selecting 'test' from the drop-down menu.
- clicking 'Close'.


# Balance

- Redesigned the Slow effect. After being slow, you can still dodge, but the dodge distance, stamina recovery speed, and action speed are reduced.
- Japhriel's skill "Slow": no longer affects targets that are immune to slow.
- Longswords: After blocking the enemy's attack successfully, get a short period of invincible time.
- Twin Daggers: After blocking the enemy's attack successfully, get a short period of invincible time.
- Shields: After blocking the enemy's attack successfully, get a short period of invincible time.
- Puppet Maggot: After being controlled for a short period of time, if the controlled character is attacked by the control caster, the controlling state will be released, and the controlled character will gain immunity to the control effect for 10 seconds.
- Survival Challenge: The final challenge battle offers better rewards.
- Hsing T'ien: The duration of stun caused by shield bash is reduced to 2 seconds.
- Eastern Depot Overseer: Adjust the orientation according to the target position when launching a revenge attack.
- Gray Immortal: Gray Immortal can no longer be controlled by Puppet Maggot in phases 1 and 3.
- Willow Immortal: Adjust the orientation according to the target position when launching a revenge attack.
- Yellow Immortal: Adjust the orientation according to the target position when launching a revenge attack.
- White Immortal: Adjust the orientation according to the target position when launching a revenge attack.
- Fox Immortal: Adjust the orientation according to the target position when launching a revenge attack.
- Arrested Spirit: Startup actions before casting the Gravity skill are removed.


# Experience Optimizations

- Optimize the dodge and run mechanism. Press and hold the dodge button to run without triggering dodging.
- Support to switch items by rolling the mouse wheel.
- After the relics take effect and be consumed, it no longer causes the corresponding set effect to disappear.
- After picking up items such as Jadesoul Pendant and Dark Gold for the first time, the picking confirmation dialog will no longer be displayed when picking up again, even if it has been consumed afterward.
- The red flashing effect displayed on the edge of the screen when your HP is low, modified to disappear after a period of time like the heartbeat sound effect.
- When the character gains immunity, all immunized buffs are immediately removed.
- Adjust the generic character animation configuration to avoid triggering revenge attack, counterattack and dodge while being stun.
- Fix an issue where Tomb Guardian drifted slowly after being slowed by Spider Web Boots.
- After the button configuration is reset caused by the data format changes, a prompt is displayed when starting the game.
- Adjust input hint text in some UI.
- Put Money Doll into Devil Slaying Log.
- Wooden Man: The triggered dialog text is set to stand within range for 2 seconds before triggering.
- Shopkeeper: The conversation ends automatically when all the money is deposited.
- Train Mode: Optional additional attacks and life enhancements.
- Dog Spirit: Optimize AI to avoid the stupid action of being beaten and still not fighting.
- Chance Meeting: Fix an issue where the follower would not use continuous attacks; optimize AI to avoid the stupid action of being beaten and still not fighting.
- Raystone Set: Improve description.
- Tome of Mastery: Only affects character targets, not small objects such as bottles and jars.
- King of Thieves: Start the fight through the dialogue option to avoid accidental hits.
- Gray Immortal: Modify death animation; the projectiles stop emitting after death.
- Yellow Immortal: Modify death animation。
- Willow Immortal: Modify death animation。
- Fallen Buddha: the projectiles stop emitting after death.


# Bug Fixes

- Kunai: Fix an issue where charged attacks could not trigger the effect of Raystone Set.
- Blunderbuss: Fix several sound effects errors.
- Twin Daggers: Fix an issue where dodge after successive attacks has a chance to trigger another attack after dodging.
- Puppet Maggot: Fix an issue where multiple enemies could be charmed at the same time in some situations; fix an issue that Puppet Maggot will not work anymore after control a non-critical enemy and leaving the room without killing it.
- Eye Devourer's Pupil: Fix an issue where the HP bar would not display for the Devil Slayer encountered in the Challenge Room of Chapter 4.
- Familiar's Heart: Fix an issue where Abomination Spirit would not immediately grow bigger when picking it up with a Familiar's Heart.
- Dragon Slayer: Fix an error in its unlocking description.
- Lord of Thunder Set: Fix an issue that the thunder ball generated sometimes stayed in the position of the dead target for a period of time.
- Bandit Berserker: Fix sound configuration error in resources.
- Skeletal Immortal: Fix an issue where the killer displayed is incorrect after you are killed by a flying tracking skull.
- Fix an issue where Tree Devil Flesh and other relics that have an effect on the dodge distance, have a different reduction value between the item description and the actual applied value.
- Fix an error caused by quick keypresses on the route selection UI.
- Fix an issue where acquiring items from weapon racks or shopping racks would not trigger plot dialogues.
- Fix an issue where the sound effect played during resurrection could only be heard from one side.
- Fix an issue where the mouse might interfere with the keyboard selection when selecting a teleport destination.
- Fix some typos.


# Localization

- Update some translated text.

notes.content:

# New Profile Type: Free Mode

- You can choose Free Mode when creating a profile.
- Unlike Standard Mode, in the Free Mode games, you can use the TAB key to open the cheat menu.
- STEAM achievements cannot be unlocked in Free Mode games.


# New Relic: Eye Devourer's Pupil

- Type: Passive.
- Function: Increases max MP by 50 points and makes enemies' HP bars visible.
- Unlocking: Defeat the final BOSS in chapter 6 to get the scroll.
- Drop Pool: BOSS pool.


Related Documents:
- "Yinyang Recipes": "The organs of beasts possessing extraordinary abilities that grant them said abilities are of equally extraordinary use in the kitchen. For example, Eye Devourer's Pupils are a top-notch ingredient. If one is able to come across a fresh pair, keep it in a dark place until all of the blood has drained from them and a fishy aroma begins to be exuded. Stewing them with goji berries, jasmine flowers, and rock crystals for two hours will lend preeminent eyesight and increased magical abilities to the consumer."
- "Strange Tales from the Yellow Springs"
Legends say that there are devils that enjoy eyeballs and that will dig them out of humans' heads. You absolutely must not look at them head for you will go blind. Such a devil truly does exist and it is called an Eye Devourer. They have but one eye that can shoot out a ray that renders enemies blind for a short period of time. That is precisely when it strikes, tearing at the throat of its enemy with its claws.


# Player Characters & Weapons

- The last part of the knockdown animation can now be cancelled by dodging.
- Fix the issue that your stamina will not continue to be consumed after triggering a block while raising the shield.
- Longsword Weapons: the recover animation of Attack1's 3rd slash can now be cancelled by doding.
- Sickle & Chain Weapons: changing the orientation after throwing a weapon in charged throw is no longer allowed.


# Items & Relics

- Soul Orb: now provide 50 soul.
- The final BOSS chest will drop an undiscovered scroll or manuscript (not including these arranged to drop in a certain place).
- Modify the manuscript drop mechanism. The drop rate of manuscript will be increased as a result.
- Vampire Bat: renamed to Cursed Blood Bat.


# Mouse Setting

- Support to change the size of mouse pointer in Mouse Setting (default set to "Auto").
- Support to restrict the mouse to the game window when in battle (default set to "On").


# Enemies

- Tomb Guardian: fix an issue that an unactivated Tomb Guardiana might disappear when attacked.


# Scenes

notes.title: 《斩妖Raksasi》V0.7发布
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34710785/fb1e56d36799a9731d99332089f4979f8ba09ae4.jpg[/img]
喵嗷~~~经历了一次跳票，《斩妖Raksasi》大更了！除了大家最关心的新主角，新关卡，新BOSS，新物品。还有游戏流程也发生重要变化 。不啰嗦，下面给大家介绍新内容！

[h1]新角色[/h1]
V0.6时代，大家已经能解锁前5个主角。这次为大家介绍V0.7的新增主角
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34710785/5634328c91abe65af3c0b0e14d8ac0f8c9dd2c9d.png[/img]
[b]绿林女王【音】[/b]
江音，是其在人族内化名，江音原名帝鸿音，魔族帝鸿氏庶出之女，由于庶出的身份，从小就被安排进杀手组织。音身手好，智谋过人，完美达成多项任务。后来因反感氏族行事方法而叛出组织，来到地面后带领一群难民落草绿林，颇为逍遥。

[b]擅长兵器【锁镰】[/b]
锁镰是奇门兵器，左手刀近攻，右手镰远投，相当全面。只是远投抓敌时，对于位置与时间的控制要求很高。锁镰最常见的攻击手段就是蓄力远投，把远处对手拉到身边，然后一顿猛砍结束战斗。

[b]专属技能【迟缓术】[/b]
声音是一种空气波动，音在组织中时掌握了它的应用技巧，可以用声音影响空气，使之变得粘滞，场景内所有敌人迟缓。移动缓慢又无法闪躲的敌人，在锁镰下就是个靶子。音的迟缓术还可以通过个人天赋【脆弱咒术】进一步提升威能。

[h1]新武器[/h1]
《斩妖Raksasi》V0.7版本总共为大家解锁[b]37把武器[/b]，其中包括了新系列的锁镰类武器，以及原来五类高级武器。限于篇幅，本文仅介绍几件，全部37把武器请在游戏中自行发现。
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34710785/fccba389a9d1d2a1a8f95e4d83d32e8464218450.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34710785/1baf2c74e82a2ed267624e35d167d2add1d100e6.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34710785/668deffbf8f9420c671df2a3eb494b82ae204405.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34710785/57e5900f9d1f3eb7d6ef0c44db3f5213ec200d28.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34710785/7cda9ded17de0b1674568961b61c1f13bca20f29.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34710785/49b3abf5ff3d71ed1dd1ea2d9b784a3bddbfc844.png[/img][/url]
[b]血滴子[/b]
锁镰榜第二的血滴子，是大内密探使用的奇门兵器，因为它攻击方式非常奇特，加上持有者身份特殊，所以总给人神秘可怕的感觉。血滴子有一个很大的刃盘，不合适抓取对手，密探们会直接旋转舞动血滴子，切割周围一切敌人，很适合应付围攻。​

[b]烈焰之刃[/b]
神族制作的神兵烈焰之刃，全刀带火焰，无惧寒冷，点燃对手，名列长刀榜第二。此长刀蓄力攻击可以挥出三股火浪，大幅度增加攻击距离，如果控制得好，可以产生二重伤害。

[b]突击盾和青金锏[/b]
盾刀榜第一，突击盾和青金锏，一直是朝廷珍藏兵器之一，用于赐予大功之臣，代表极大的荣誉。当持有者去逝，这一对盾锏需要归还朝廷，直到某一位持有者死于战场上，这神兵失落民间。青金锏很沉重，可以击晕对手，而突击盾坚硬有棱，可以持盾撞倒敌人。

[h1]新关卡[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34710785/f125f3de37d4016e3d2af4922a12bd85ebc508e6.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34710785/7c6c20d5b8045bfd7a6d02939098044415fb4883.png[/img]
[b]古庙[/b]
这是一个非常古老的庙宇，虽然年代久远，但依然看到很多宏伟雕像。这里是人族封印地底世界出口之地。先祖以信仰之力驱动着这里的守护傀儡，守护着不让魔族重新回到地面。但随时间过去，这里的守护封印被腐化了，不但很多魔族从封印中出来，古人留下的法器和机关傀儡也开始失控。

在古庙中，有着从通道出来的魔族先行部队，有着为数不多的守护僧侣，更有神器机关。需要特别注意那些神器机关，它们已经失控，会进行无差别的攻击。别看神器机关行动不灵活，但坚硬的身体和破坏力，对于任何人类来说都是致命的。

[b]地城[/b]
这个地下城，是上古之战时沉入地下的九黎城寨，岁月变迁，成了现在这样子。这里由窄长的甬道以及空旷的洞穴构成，各处遍布骸骨。大量骸骨明显来自魔族，另外的骸骨则是来自巨型的地下生物。可以看出，魔族初入地下世界，付出了极之惨痛的代价。

现在的地下城，已经完全在魔族的控制之中，变幻的魔法阵，活跃好战的魔族与妖兽，充满战前的激情，这一切都表示着，魔族不久将有重大行动。
根据间谍回传的消息，在地下城存在大量罗刹，这由人魔混血而生的种族，本很难存活成长，如此之多的数量，极不寻常。

[h1]新BOSS[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34710785/93984603b845cdad499012cc9113fe1e77917ac2.png[/img]
[b]邢天[/b]
上古魔族有战神刑天，力大无穷神勇超常。一场大战中，刑天之头被砍，却是从身躯上长出人脸，继续持斧盾战斗，实力有增无减，害人族战士无数。直至上古之战结束，刑天也从未倒下。有传说，这位魔族战神有不死之身，至今依然活跃于魔族之中。

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34710785/aabe0ec9977626b9f4bca0936d509be08a642c1c.png[/img]
[b]堕佛像[/b]
人族不愿意踏足地下，也不愿意让魔族重回地面。于是由镇魔族在通道之上建立强大封印，他们希望能把魔族永远封印在地下。在通道口，镇魔族修建了一个巨大的佛像神器，它的职责就是堵住通道。几千年来，受魔族灵气侵蚀，佛像神器出现故障，而没落的镇魔族，已经失去了维修佛像神器能力。

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34710785/8dd7a1e04aaa6513411d4079da98077e4ebe17bb.png[/img]
[b]不动明王[/b]
镇魔族安置大量神器以保护封印，所有神器中，最重要一个是不动明王。不动明王是整个封印大阵的阵灵，传说说各个神器的雷电之力都是来自它。这个无可撼动的光明使者，镇压着魔族通道数千年。它的职责，是击杀所有要通过的生物，无论目标是谁。

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34710785/2c9f73004232d7dac5574cb42d1093958f678734.png[/img]
[b]白仙[/b]
五大仙在妖族中赫赫有名，它们各自拥有自己的势力，爪牙覆盖到神州四海八方。白仙是刺猬妖，是一名刀客，五妖帅中武艺最高的一个，单论战斗，其它四位都敌不过白仙。白仙不好杀，而喜欢论武，常与各族高手比试。

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34710785/9c2d017792df918bd886543b567e0642627aef77.png[/img]
[b]巨锤罗刹[/b]
人魔二族相争，自上古至今世代不息。偶有人魔苟合诞下异种，体强壮，有异能，男为罗刹，女名罗刹斯，能食人屠魔啖妖。有命数仙师预言，天地将终于此族。世人甚惧，遂为三界不容，其路艰辛。

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34710785/b465d99fcc94e4acaa0971a444365d367bdc523c.png[/img]
[b]狐仙[/b]
五大仙在妖族中赫赫有名，它们各自拥有自己的势力，爪牙覆盖到神州四海八方。狐仙为五仙之首，手下不但媚狐无数，本体也天生媚骨，擅操控人心，仍妖中之帅，极受魔族重用。

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34710785/59cda78adadc6ba1337731f788770dcde20c62ad.png[/img]
[b]拘魂[/b]
暗器榜排名第一是拘魂飞刀。据称，最强暗杀组织——诡面——其首领名为拘魂，擅长把咒杀术应用于暗器之上，夺命拘魂从不失手。近年诡面暗杀组越来越壮大，但其首领拘魂却很少出手了。

[h1]新系统[/h1]
通过每一个章节，都会进入刹之屋。在这里，你可以消耗收集到的刹气，解锁游戏内容，升级角色天赋，以及炼制新秘宝。
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34710785/656f348fd5bc5f8720f90d2fd1373d64a6228827.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34710785/982e8f42f12803d279eb4074c53db26eec1e6cf8.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34710785/09f124b4eb1cb809656909169c3e8bbd0c331188.png[/img]
